mathsAndAnswerVerdict: PASS. Each rectangle has width pi/6. The curve intersects their upper left corners, so heights sin(pi/6)=1/2 and sin(pi/3)=sqrt(3)/2. Sum = pi/6*(1/2+sqrt(3)/2) = (1+sqrt(3))*pi/12 square units, uniquely option D; short and worked answers agree. The unshaded [0,pi/6] interval has a left-endpoint height sin(0)=0, so its left rectangle has zero area and need not appear; this is interpretation, not an added given. The two visible rectangles themselves suffice to compute the stated approximation.
